verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares documents saving frequently used vesting schedules as predefined schedules that prepopulate grant vesting details. Vesting schedules feed ASC 718 reporting, and the 'Exercise Now' indicator implies the platform tracks which options are exercisable. No evidence covers cliffs, milestone-based vesting, or acceleration on exit, and automatic vested-vs-unvested tracking is only implied. Missing for 10: documented cliff configuration, milestone/performance vesting, single/double-trigger acceleration on exit, explicit vested-vs-unvested tracking, independent corroboration.
